detail: Sit with the business problem before touching a solution: talk to stakeholders, read the workflow, find where the friction actually lives.
Break the problem into requirements, gaps and constraints. Map process flows and surface what's assumed but never written down.
Prioritize by impact vs. effort. Decide what an MVP must prove before a roadmap gets built around it.
Translate strategy into user stories, acceptance criteria and specs engineering can execute against without ambiguity.
Track adoption, KPIs and UAT feedback against the outcome the business actually needed, not just the shipped feature.
Feed results back into the next iteration — a product is a loop, not a launch.
